title: Icee Lion:
headline: A Lion from the Philippines loves meeting friends from all over the world, and the Leo friend she grew up in Lions with became family.
story: Icee is a Lion from the Philippines and a past Leo advisory panelist. Her happiness is meeting friends from all over the world, in person at last after meeting online. Her close friend started with her in Leos and is now the multiple district Leo chairperson. They grew from Leos to Lions together, shared their leadership styles, and became family.
Friendship carries every beat. Leadership, Jacqui's other ask, sits inside it: they share their leadership styles. The button is on the selfie with her friend in the frame.
Loops: L1 “What makes her happy?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:04. L2 “Who is like family to her?” opens at 0:11 and closes on “We became family” (about 0:32).
